Header: Virus vector (Whitefly, Bemisia tabaci ) local name; Sinhala- Bandakka kaha narati berime virasaya

Prevention: Select a field free of virus infected plants
Establish banana plants as a barrier around the okra cultivation one or two months before planting
Use rice straw as a mulch
Monitoring: Immature leaves turns into light yellow with clear yellow veins
Misshaped and yellowish pods can be seen at the later stage of infection
Direct Control: Remove and destroy symptomatic okra and other weeds (Hulanthala, Kapukinissa)
Neem oil (1 ml/1 l+teepol 2 ml) one month after planting and repeat in three weeks intervals
Spray insecticides to control the vector (seed yellow direct control)
Restrictions: Maximum number of sprays per season- not more than two.
Slightly toxic to predatory mites and other beneficial.
Spray in early morning when the activity of whitefly is low
